column1: The dataset contains **284,807 credit card transactions**, of which only **492 transactions are fraudulent**. This highlights the highly imbalanced nature of the dataset, where fraudulent transactions represent only a very small percentage of the total transactions.
- **284,807** total transactions are present in the dataset.
- Only **492 transactions** are classified as fraudulent.
- Fraudulent transactions account for approximately **0.17%** of all transactions.
- The significant class imbalance makes fraud detection challenging and highlights the importance of using appropriate evaluation metrics and balancing techniques.
